plugins.name: karvey
plugins.description: Karvey Method (Afán, Selknam): stack-agnostic spec-driven development as a spiral — 13-phase pipeline (0–12) with approval gates enforced by a state tool and hooks, plus 18 support skills: iteration loop, BUG-NN incident tracker, discovery backlog, engineering standards, QA with a security gate, ordered deployment. Works with the team's configured tracker (ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Azure Boards, GitHub Projects, spreadsheet or Markdown) and notification channel. Optional team layer for teams of agent sessions.
